runs.title: The seed conjecture for reflexive polytopes, 19 October 2026

records.evidence: of 400 reflexive 3-polytopes, 7 have no reflexive vertex deletion and 237 have a cover that is not a vertex deletion

change.old: delete a vertex and keep the hull of the other lattice points
change.new: a cover, found as the cut of P by a half-space <x,q> >= -1 at a dual lattice point q
change.improves: covers found (vertex deletion misses one on 237 of 400 polytopes)

records.failed_part: cuts at dual points of gauge 2
records.evidence: the cuts give the wrong set of covers for 73 of 400 polytopes

change.new: every dual point allowed by the dual volume bound of Balletti, Kasprzyk and Nill and the facet condition, branching where a cut is not reflexive
change.improves: polytopes with the right set of covers (327 of 400)

records.evidence: the covers agree with the known order on 400 of 400 three-dimensional polytopes; the four-dimensional list has 473,800,776 polytopes

change.old: compute a descent of each polytope
change.new: bound every descent by the lattice points of the polytope and of its dual, read once from the list
change.improves: polytopes with a proved bound on every descent (none)

records.evidence: every descent has at most min(|P| - 6, 680 - |P*|) steps, at most 654 over all 473,800,776 polytopes
the longest chain of point-count pairs with |P| falling and |P*| rising has 348 steps, from (521, 22); every descent has at most 348 steps
162,328,050 polytopes have a counting bound above 40; certifying each needs a descent or an exact depth, about 3 minutes for the largest

change.old: certify a descent of every polytope
change.new: certify descents of the extreme polytopes only, and bound the constant from below by exact breadth-first depths
change.improves: certified upper and lower bounds on the sharp constant

records.failed_part: exact depths of the largest polytopes
records.evidence: a certified descent of 38 steps from the 680-point simplex; exact depths 4 and 9 at its polytopes with 15 and 20 points, so the constant is at least 9

change.old: one certified descent of the 680-point simplex
change.new: exact depths at the polytopes along that descent
change.improves: the bound on the depth of the 680-point simplex (38)

records.failed_part: exact depths near the top of the pair bound
records.evidence: the polytope at step 27 has exact depth 9, so the 680-point simplex has depth at most 36; the sharp constant lies between 9 and 348

runs.title: The Hodge conjecture at E_0^6 and the chain for sqrt 10, 19 October 2026

records.failed_part: the sixfold Massey product m_6 on the chain of length six
records.evidence: for L^1[-2], L^2[-1], L^3[0], L^4[1] the isolated blocks are 0 and the Euler characteristic is -17665, so counting decides nothing, and the product needs an A-infinity model in theta functions that the library does not have

change.old: count the isolated Ext blocks, then the ranks of the Massey products along the closed chains
change.new: first find the threefold pieces that lie on no closed chain with a nonzero cochain on all but one step, and compare the parity of shift the chains reach with the parity the Chern character forces
change.improves: configurations of family (a) decided (every one with at most five line bundles, for any twists, against none)

records.evidence: every convolution with at most five line bundles fails (experiments/hodge/C1_chains.md, Theorem 6); with two line bundles at one shift the Maurer-Cartan component has a second path, and chains with two runs through threefolds appear

change.old: a chain through a threefold acts when its cochain is nonzero on all but one step
change.new: a zero step beside a nonzero step that is the only path between two line bundles carries no deformation (Lemma 7); search every interval of shifts (Lemma 8)
change.improves: configurations of family (a) decided (at most seven line bundles, against five)

records.evidence: every convolution with at most seven line bundles fails (experiments/hodge/C8_chains.md, Theorem 9); with eight, 31 shift patterns such as the Koszul tower carry live chains of both parities, every Maurer-Cartan component between line bundles two shifts apart has two paths, and the decision needs the ranks of the products along the runs

records.failed_part: the chain S -> Y <- S' through symplectic quotients of orders 2 and 5
records.evidence: the coinvariant lattice of an automorphism of order five has rank 16, so S' has transcendental rank at most 5, while real multiplication by Q(sqrt 10) needs rank at least 6

change.old: admit a chain whose multiplier is right modulo squares
change.new: also require that every surface of the chain can carry the endomorphism field: transcendental rank at least 3[E:Q] against the rank each symplectic quotient allows
change.improves: chain candidates rejected at admission instead of left open
